{{Quote|As the song says, 'Love is no match for a blaster at your side.'|HoloNet News|<ref name="HNN" />}}
A '''song''' was composed some time before [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|56|business/13516_4.html|Balmorran Secures Musician Rearmament Contract}} is set on the date 13:5:16, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> A line from the [[Music/Legends|song]], "love is no match for a blaster by your side," was used as a colloquial phrase by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] quoted the song thusly in "Balmorran Secures Musician Rearmament Contract", an article about a union of [[Musician/Legends|musicians]] called the [[Melody Fellowship]] that signed an arms deal with the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturer [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]].<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The song was mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 56|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #56'']], a<ref name="HNN" /> [[May 16]], [[2002]]<ref name="HNN56 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6873383|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=ForceAlly|date=2002-05-16|time=5:34 PM|archivedate=20200305125429}}</ref> issue of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]].<ref name="HNN" /> The article that referenced the song was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
